Let's begin! Understanding that what we eat (and don't eat) every day is what allows us to sleep better, pay more attention in class, remember important facts, and improve our performance at the gym or if we practice a sport.

Dr. Diana Carolina Gómez is the head of the Medical Service and Occupational Safety and Health at the University, and she told us that the brain is quite "eccentric" and, unlike the rest of the body which does use stored energy, our brain needs new sources of energy.

That's why when we skip meals, overindulge in sweets, or eat in a rush with one hand while the other is on our phone or computer, it shows in our emotions, our attitude, or even if we sleep for up to eight hours and still feel just as tired. Will you join the challenge?

###### Viruses versus bacteria: PhageLife's proposal for the swine sector from EAFIT

On a pig farm, a bacterial infection can jeopardize the animals' health and the farm's productivity. Furthermore, the problem becomes more complex when the bacteria stop responding to the antibiotics that previously combated them. To explore another approach, the company [PhageLife](https://phagelife.co/) is developing customized solutions using bacteriophages, naturally occurring viruses capable of eliminating specific bacteria.
